jobs.name: CommunityA
jobs.prompt: Use the attached reference sheet ONLY for the ART STYLE of the game: chunky stylized low-poly 3D, flat-shaded facets, bold saturated colors, simple cartoon eyes, soft underwater light (Schedule I meets Abzu). A square emblem for a game studio's Roblox community icon. A round badge fills most of the square: a thick dark navy ring with a bright teal inner rim, and inside it a small round orange-and-yellow fish with big white googly eyes (the hero, called the Nibbler) leaping out of a curling teal wave with a white foam crest, mouth closed in a cheeky confident grin, a few round bubbles. Behind the badge, a deep ocean-blue background fading darker at the corners. Bold, simple, centered, readable at very small sizes, strong silhouette. Crisp, professional mascot logo. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
